description.value: A campground within Horne Lake Regional Park on Vancouver Island, where a freshwater lake and the nearby Horne Lake Caves make for an active stop; the access road off Highway 19A is a rural mix of pavement and gravel passable by regular vehicles. No amenity details were recoverable from the scraped pages.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched is the RDN (Regional District of Nanaimo) regional government portal for 'Camping at Horne Lake Regional Park'; the retrieved content is dominated by site navigation and unrelated subpages (ESS, bylaw services, fire FAQ), yielding no campground-specific amenity detail beyond what OSM provides. OSM tags supply the primary amenity signals: shower=no (explicit negative), tents=yes, caravans=yes, openfire=yes, internet_access=no. No phone or address appears in either source, and the website URL in OSM matches the fetched domain, confirming the web reference.
concerns: Fetched website content is almost entirely site-wide navigation; the actual /camping-at-horne-lake page body did not render, so most amenity fields remain null and should be manually verified.

OSM name is 'North Park Campground' while the RDN website refers to the broader 'Horne Lake Regional Park' — the campground may be one named loop or section within the park; the relationship should be confirmed.
No phone number or physical address in OSM or on the fetched page.
shower=no and internet_access=no sourced from OSM tags only — not independently confirmed by website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate regional-park campground operated by a regional government body on Vancouver Island; tent camping is explicitly supported and it sits in an area relevant to touring cyclists exploring inland Vancouver Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: Open fires permitted per OSM openfire=yes. Both tents and caravans accepted per OSM. No internet access per OSM internet_access=no.

wow_evidence: a freshwater lake and the nearby Horne Lake Caves
